Draw parameter sets

simulate_params.Rd

Draws parameter sets for the stochastic dose calculation: each drawn parameter from its distribution, around its value in the parameter list.

Usage

simulate_params(
  n,
  params = load_params(),
  distributions = load_distributions(),
  sar_sd = 0.25
)

Arguments

n

Number of parameter sets

params

Parameter list, as returned by load_params(). Its values are the means of the distributions.

distributions

Nested list of distributions, as returned by load_distributions()

sar_sd

Standard deviation of the SAR values, relative to their value. With 0, the SAR values are not drawn.

Value

Matrix with one row per parameter set and one column per drawn parameter and SAR value, named by its path in the parameter list (sections separated by "."). Parameters that are not drawn keep their value in params.

Details

The parameters of a Dirichlet group are drawn together, so that they sum to 1 in every draw.

The SAR values are drawn too, from a lognormal distribution around their value in the parameter list, with standard deviation sar_sd times the value. SAR values with the same value for the same tissue come from the same simulation and are drawn together; SAR values of 0 stay 0.

The SAR values are drawn after the other parameters, so the draws of the other parameters do not depend on sar_sd. Use set.seed() before for reproducible draws.

See also

load_distributions()
